summary: Reads the global framerate counter dword_7CF230, selects a performance setting tier (0 when the counter is at or below 16, otherwise 2) into the field at this+0x310, formats the counter as a decimal string into a stack buffer using the %d format literal, then updates the UI edit buffer with that string.

operations.description: Read global framerate counter value into v1
When the framerate counter is at or below 16, write performance tier 0 into the field at this+0x310
When the framerate counter exceeds 16, write performance tier 2 into the field at this+0x310
Format the framerate counter into the stack buffer using the %d format literal via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck
Update the UI edit buffer with the formatted string via EditBufferStringUpdate

unresolved: Meaning of the performance tier values (0 and 2) and whether the field at this+0x310 is persisted by callers is not established.
